title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Bill Reutelhuber transfer: PCM > Sony PCM601esd (spdif out) > VX Pocket/Laptop > Nuendo > Wav 16/44
source: Anonymous Recording (FOB): (3) Nakamichi 700s (DBX II) > Master Cassette > PCM (2)

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house PCM recording captures a powerhouse 1982 show with standout versions of Ship of Fools, Crazy Fingers, Women Is Smarter and a rollicking Franklin’s Tower.
ai_review.review: The review praises the performance as an exceptional, high‑energy set that feels like a 1977‑style bravado in the first set and a joyous, flowing second set. The PCM front‑of‑house source is described as clear and vibrant, with Jerry, Brent and the drums sounding great despite some occasional saturation.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review highlights an outstanding musical performance and a high‑quality PCM front‑of‑house recording, warranting a strong rating despite limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Drawn from a PCM source (front‑of‑house), very clear with Jerry and drums sounding good; Brent on keys also shines. Some saturation noted but overall crisp and preferred over other versions.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised for its 1977‑like bravado; second set described as wonderful and joyous from beginning to end, maintaining high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: More reserved and sweet early on (Ship of Fools) then turns up the heat with raging runs; “dancing on water” during Women Is Smarter.
band_member_comments.Phil: Drops bombs all night, saturates the source but adds power; this was his second‑to‑last tour with the four‑string bass, playing big time.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as a complete rock star for the night, delivering an energetic performance throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboardist) sounds great in the mix and contributes to the overall strength of the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Jerry and the drums sound quite good, providing solid rhythmic support.
